+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_cause", [False, True])
+async def test_application_exception_chain_is_preserved(explicit_cause: bool) -> None:
+    async def error_app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        try:
+            raise ValueError("The root exception")
+        except ValueError as exc:
+            if explicit_cause:
+                raise RuntimeError("The application exception") from exc
+            raise RuntimeError("The application exception")
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        raise AssertionError("receive should not be called")  # pragma: no cover
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        raise AssertionError("send should not be called")  # pragma: no cover
+
+    app = BaseHTTPMiddleware(error_app, dispatch=passthrough)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc_info:
+        await app({"type": "http"}, receive, send)
+
+    visible_context = exc_info.value.__cause__ or (
+        None if exc_info.value.__suppress_context__ else exc_info.value.__context__
+    )
+    assert isinstance(visible_context, ValueError)
+    assert str(visible_context) == "The root exception"
+
+
